headline: The arcade now plays itself every night
lede: 31 contract games get a seeded bot run at 03:30: crashes, softlocks and broken invariants get filed as QA issues with the exact seed to reproduce them, and /forge shows a pass/fail row per game.

notes.text: nightlybot.mjs drives every game to completion via the __game contract — a run that freezes is a softlock; one that just never dies is endurance, not a defect.
The first soak earned its keep: false stalls on terminal game-over steps, by-design seed folds (Lemmings, Gauntlet) and endurance conflations were all caught and fixed before any issue went out.
Three green nights close #1040 by themselves — the soak reports its own verdict, no human bookkeeping.
Vercel's queue sat behind the QA lane's merges at shift end; the board panel lights up with tonight's first nightly.json push.
